title: ChessPlusPlus Game Configuration
description: Configuration schema for a hex-grid tactics game. Uses axial coordinates (q, r). Matches DEFAULT_CONFIG in server/game/engine/config_loader.py and client config.service.ts.

radius.description: Hex grid radius (distance from centre hex to edge). The default board is radius 11 (12 cells per hexagon edge).

orientation.description: Cosmetic: how the client draws the board hexagon. Default is edge-up.

units.description: Unit type definitions, keyed by unit id.

display.description: Per-colour display glyphs rendered on the board.

move.description: Number of adjacent-hex steps this unit can move per turn. Movement floods outward through the six hex neighbours. A unit walks through its own - an ally costs a step to pass but is not somewhere to stop - while an enemy blocks the hex and the way past it alike.

value.description: Unit worth in UP, also used for phase loss scoring.

hp.description: Maximum hit points for this unit type.

attack.description: Attack before defense. An integer uses rules.rangeFalloff beyond the first ring. A list supplies exact attack for rings attackMinRange through attackRange, ignoring rangeFalloff; it must have one entry per supported ring, at most four.

commander.description: This unit is the side's commander. Under the 'regicide' objective, losing every commander loses the game. Omitted means false.

attackRange.description: Outermost ring this unit can strike, by hex distance and ignoring obstacles. Scalar attack falls off by rules.rangeFalloff per ring beyond 1; a list gives each supported ring its own attack. Omitted means 1.

attackMinRange.description: Innermost ring this unit can strike or counterattack. Must not exceed attackRange. Omitted means 1. An attack list starts at this ring.

defense.description: Flat damage reduction applied when this unit is attacked. strike_damage() subtracts it from the incoming attack, floored at 0.

ability.description: Catalogue id of this unit type's own ability, cast from the Unit panel onto the unit itself - so it must be a 'friendly' one. Paid from its side's purse like the same ability anywhere else; its cooldown and uses are the unit's own. Omitted means the unit has none.

heal.description: Healing amount at distances 1 through the number of entries. Replaces this unit’s attack action: heal one other friendly battlefield unit, optionally after moving, capped at its max HP, with no CP cost. At most four adjacent hex rings. Omitted means this unit has no healing action.

captureZones.description: Zones this unit can capture or neutralize: home is its own 3x zone, enemy the opposing 3x zone, middle the 2x zone, side either 1x zone. Empty means none; omitted means unrestricted for older configs. Permissions also determine which enemies can prevent full-zone control from the centre.

veterancy.description: Permanent stats unlocked at vet 1. hp, move, defense and scalar attack are additive; an attack list replaces the base profile. attackRange, attackMinRange and heal replace the corresponding base field. Current and maximum HP each rise by hp once, without reviving dead units. Omitted means no first-star stat change.

attack.description: Scalar adds to every attack tier; a list replaces the profile at vet 1.

attackRange.description: Outermost ring this unit can strike, by hex distance and ignoring obstacles. Scalar attack falls off by rules.rangeFalloff per ring beyond 1; a list gives each supported ring its own attack. Omitted means 1.

attackMinRange.description: Innermost ring this unit can strike or counterattack. Must not exceed attackRange. Omitted means 1. An attack list starts at this ring.

heal.description: Healing amount at distances 1 through the number of entries. Replaces this unit’s attack action: heal one other friendly battlefield unit, optionally after moving, capped at its max HP, with no CP cost. At most four adjacent hex rings. Omitted means this unit has no healing action.

passive.description: Catalogue id of the unit passive unlocked at Vet 2. Omitted means none. Unit passives currently execute in solo play.

abilities.description: The ability catalogue and how a side gets at it. Keyed by a STABLE id throughout - never by position - because a side's saved loadout, path and cooldowns are written by id, and a reordered list would otherwise re-point every one of them. The engine still does not read abilities; the client does, and this is where their numbers live so that tuning one is a config edit.

slots.description: How many pool abilities a side may carry at once. Picks come in pairs, so this is even.

pool.description: Catalogue ids a side picks its loadout from, in pairs: the first two are one pick, the next two another. An even number of them.

paths.description: The ways a side can specialise. One per match.

passive.description: Catalogue id, granted free with the path. Always on: only its mov/atk/def mean anything.

ultimate.description: Catalogue id. Once a match unless its catalogue entry sets `uses`.

utility.description: Catalogue id for the path action replacing Reselect. Omitted preserves the legacy pair swap.

catalogue.description: Every ability, keyed by its own id.

target.description: What a cast is aimed at. 'universal' needs no target and grants points. 'all-enemies' needs no target and changes stats on the enemy battlefield and green reserve units present when cast. Red base units and later arrivals are excluded; affected units keep the effect when returning to base. 'hex' selects any rendered hex, including empty and panel hexes; recipients are captured at casting. 'pair' selects a carried pool pair.

cost.description: Cast cost: points for the pool and legacy unit abilities, UP for Vet 3 unit effects, CP for paths.

cooldown.description: How many of its side's turns it cannot be cast again for after a cast. Omitted means 3.

turns.description: How many caster turns a temporary stat or status effect lasts. It expires at that caster's turn start after this many full turns. Omitted means 1. Damage, healing, promotion, recharge and points happen immediately.

uses.description: Maximum casts per match, or per phase with usesScope phase; per side for panel abilities and per unit for unit abilities. Omitted means unlimited, except a path ultimate defaults to one.

damage.description: HP taken off the target. Enemy abilities only.

heal.description: HP given back to the target, up to its maximum. Friendly abilities only.

points.description: Points the cast hands its caster - always points, whichever currency bought the ability. Universal abilities only.

testing.description: Marks a testing/catalogue entry such as Rally. The shipped pool excludes it; this marker alone does not restrict a configured custom ability online.

effect.description: Configured unit or CP path behavior, executed in solo and authoritative multiplayer. Capture unlocks at Vet 2: a sole capturing side holds the zone except eligible enemy occupants; opposing active Capture passives restore normal claims.

counterAttack.description: Counter ATK by distance, starting at ring 1, before DEF and ability modifiers.

up.description: UP granted by Sacrifice, independently of its UP cost.

enemyDamage.description: Immediate enemy HP damage from Call.

enemyAtk.description: Enemy ATK change from Call for one full turn.

enemyDef.description: Enemy DEF change from Call for one full turn.

minVet.description: Minimum rank for a path passive. Omitted preserves the legacy first-star gate.

stars.description: Immediate permanent stars granted by Strengthen or selected Sacrifice, capped at vet 3. On Sacrifice, this opts into one friendly battlefield/green-reserve recipient, full healing, and an optional unused friendly battlefield extra actor; omission preserves legacy army-wide Sacrifice.

recharge.description: Cooldown removed from each half of a carried pair. Positive cooldowns stop at 1; already-ready abilities stay at 0.

splashDamage.description: Direct HP damage to occupants of the six hexes adjacent to the chosen hex.

splashAtk.description: ATK modifier for adjacent hex recipients.

splashMov.description: MOV modifier for adjacent hex recipients.

setAtk.description: Set the existing stat to this value; subsequent modifiers apply after the latest setting. Does not grant an absent attack/healing profile.

enemyDefSet.description: Absolute DEF assigned to enemy recipients, overriding temporary DEF modifiers.

scope.description: Recipient zones for selected friendly/enemy casts, path passives and path effects. field-reserve excludes red bases; all (or omitted scope on a selected cast) includes every zone. Passives also apply to later eligible arrivals; temporary casts capture only current recipients.

hel.description: Temporary modifier to each ring of an existing normal healing profile.

setHel.description: Set the existing stat to this value; subsequent modifiers apply after the latest setting. Does not grant an absent attack/healing profile.

splashHel.description: Healing modifier for adjacent hex recipients.

usesScope.description: Scope of the uses budget. Omitted means match. Phase means initialization, each numbered phase including halftime/postmatch, or all overtime stages together; requires uses.

area.description: Horizontal board-wide line for hex-cleave, or four diagonal rays for hex-trap. Omitted preserves the legacy radial area. The shape includes base/reserve cells and follows board orientation.

splashRange.description: Nearest steps receiving the splash effect; omitted means one. Line areas count cells along the line.

outerRange.description: Last ring reached by hex-sap, beyond splashRange. Omitted reaches only splashRange.

outerAtk.description: Nonnegative ATK boost to hex-sap outer-ring occupants on either side; requires outerRange.

outerHel.description: Nonnegative HEL boost to existing healers in hex-sap outer ring on either side; requires outerRange.

outerMov.description: Nonnegative MOV boost on hex-trap outer diagonal rays beyond splashRange; requires cross area.

radius.description: Call effect range in adjacent hex steps, excluding the caster. Omitted preserves the older army-wide Call.

enemyMov.description: Temporary MOV modifier to enemy recipients of a unit Call.

pairPickDelay.description: Full turns after a side first picks a pool pair before it can fill a second pair. A pick on Turn 1 with delay 5 unlocks on Turn 6. Omitted preserves immediate picking in older configs.

white.description: Map of 'q,r' coordinate strings to unit type ids for white. A battlefield hex stands the unit on the board; a hex of white's own panels (the bottom two: base bottom-left, reserve bottom-right) deals it into that panel - the default puts each side's base squad there. A hex in the other side's panels, or a commander in any panel, is refused.

black.description: Map of 'q,r' coordinate strings to unit type ids for black. A battlefield hex stands the unit on the board; a hex of black's own panels (the top two: base top-right, reserve top-left) deals it into that panel - the default puts each side's base squad there. A hex in the other side's panels, or a commander in any panel, is refused.

turnTimeLimit.description: Per-turn time limit in seconds (0 = unlimited).

rangeFalloff.description: Fraction of attack damage lost per ring beyond the first, applied linearly: ring 2 deals (1 - falloff) of the attack stat, ring 3 (1 - 2*falloff), floored, never below 1.

minStrikeDamage.description: The least a blow that lands may deal, after defence is subtracted. 1 (the default) means armour blunts a hit but never turns it aside: without it a pawn (14 attack) took nothing at all off a shieldman (18 defence), so whole matchups were dead on the board with no rule saying so. 0 restores that, letting armour absorb a hit entirely. An attacker with no attack stat deals 0 either way - this lifts a blow that was blunted, not one that was never thrown.

objective.description: Win condition. 'regicide' (the default): a side loses when it has no commander left. 'elimination': a side loses when it has no units left at all.

cpAtStart.description: The CP each side starts the match with, to buy the path abilities with before the first postmatch award. Default 5.

cpPhaseOffset.description: The base of the CP each side is awarded once at the start of a phase's postmatch: Phase N's award is N times this (10, 20 and 30 at the default), plus both sides' scores for the phase, plus the gap between them for the side that scored less. Default 10.

upAtStart.description: Unit points each side starts with; omitted means 10. UP pays unit crossings and receives unit kill rewards, homecoming refunds and halftime VP snapshots.

pointsAtStart.description: Regular ability points each side starts with; omitted means 10. Added once to normal own-turn income, numbered-phase grants and overtime VP conversion.
